court: In the High Court of Madras†
advocates: For R-1 to R-3 : Mr. A.S. Abul Kalam Azad Government Advocate (Crl. Side)
judgment_text:
Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, to issue a writ of mandamus, directing the respondents to consider the petitioner's representation dated 29-4-2026 and provide adequate police protection for the “Kalari Festival” of Arulmighu Sri. Ponrakku Amman and Arulmigu Sri. Sangaiah Swamy Temple at P. Pudupatti Village on 31-5-2026 and 1-6-2026.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Srimathy, J.:— The present Writ Petition has been filed for the issuance of a writ of mandamus, to direct the official respondents to consider the petitioner's representation dated 29-4-2026 and provide adequate police protection for the “Kalari Festival” of Arulmighu Sri. Ponrakku Amman and Arulmigu Sri. Sangaiah Swamy Temple at P. Pudupatti Village on 31-5-2026 and 1-6-2026.

2. This Court without expressing any opinion on merits is directing the official respondents to consider the petitioner's representation, dated 29-4-2026 and pass orders in accordance to law within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

3. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of. There shall be no order as to costs.
